# Identify consecutive sequences of anomaly data points per component-KPI pair
# We define a fault as consecutive anomaly points with no time gap larger than a threshold (e.g., 1 minute)
# Calculate time difference between consecutive anomaly points per group
anomaly_df['time_diff'] = anomaly_df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'kpi_name'])['datetime'].diff().dt.total_seconds()

# Define a new fault group when time difference is greater than 60 seconds or NaN (first point)
anomaly_df['fault_group'] = (anomaly_df['time_diff'].isna() | (anomaly_df['time_diff'] > 60)).cumsum()

# Aggregate faults by fault_group, component, KPI
faults = (
    anomaly_df
    .groupby(['cmdb_id', 'kpi_name', 'fault_group'])
    .agg(
        fault_start_time=('datetime', 'min'),
        fault_end_time=('datetime', 'max'),
        max_value=('value', 'max'),
        max_threshold=('P95_threshold', 'max')
    )
    .reset_index(drop=False)
)

# Calculate maximum threshold breach as (max_value - max_threshold) / max_value

# Filter out faults where max threshold breach is less than or equal to 50%
